name: Pneumatic
description: Unlocks [color=#20E9C1]Gust Mode[/color]: push things away. Shots recoil; slammed mobs take damage. Coyote jump and double jump. Stasis Grenade: what it sticks to is held, then takes all its stored knockback at once.

badge.name: Bellows Core
badge.description: Unlocks [color=#20E9C1]Gust Mode[/color]: push things away. Shots recoil; slammed mobs take damage. Double jump. Stasis Grenade: what it sticks to is held, then takes all its stored knockback at once.

commons.name: Featherfall
commons.description: No fall damage. Hold Jump to fall slowly. Charging a weapon in the air slows your fall even more.

commons.name: Air Control
commons.description: Better steering in the air, without braking.

adept.name: Gale Force
adept.description: Gust hits a wider area. Hit enemies take more fall damage.

master.name: Bunny Hop
master.description: Jump right as you land to build speed. Hold Jump to keep hopping.

master.name: Pile Driver
master.description: Sneak to charge a jump. Sneak in the air to slam down, harder the further you fell.

grandmaster.name: Cyclone
grandmaster.description: A full-charge Gust becomes a slow whirlwind that lifts mobs and items for 3s, then bursts.

grandmaster.name: Rebound
grandmaster.description: Gusted enemies bounce off walls and each other.
